description: Header file defining a generic log formatter class and metric value formatters for the ocudulog namespace, including templates and virtual functions for formatting log entries and metrics.

classes.name: log_formatter
classes.description: Abstract base class for formatting log entries and contexts with virtual methods for customization.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the formatter.

methods.name: format_full_queue_error
methods.description: Formats a full queue error string into the buffer.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log entry given its metadata into the buffer.

methods.name: format_ctx
methods.description: Formats context and log entry into the buffer, handling nested structures.

methods.name: iterate_tuple
methods.description: Processes all elements in a tuple for formatting.

methods.name: process_element
methods.description: Overloaded functions to process metric sets, lists, and individual metrics.

methods.name: format_metric_set_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning metric set formatting.

methods.name: format_metric_set_end
methods.description: Callback for ending metric set formatting.
